newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Late Ukraine budget slows int'l bond debut-FinMin.
newsitem.headline: Late Ukraine budget slows int'l bond debut-FinMin.

text.p: Ukraine's hopes to issue soon its first foreign bonds are being held up because the country has not passed its 1997 budget yet, a deputy finance minister said on Thursday.
"We are working on the issue but we are being held up by the lack of a budget," Mykhailo Honcharuk told a news conference.
Honcharuk said Ukraine would have little chance of getting a credit rating without a budget, which parliament is due to review this month.
